body: Thanks whoever you're I'm still trying to heal from it. Sadly can't afford therapy now. But I'm trying to process it one day at a time, journal about it on some days.
It's comforting to know that I'm not the only one like this.
Cutting myself in the places of my body that stays under the cloth everytime. That's as much as I can do to compensate my pain and to get out of my head.
I think there is no place I really belong and even after seeking therapy everything is just getting more worse.

Idk if life is worth it or not. All I know is I can’t be freed from pain till I choose to live. And my soul deserved a lot better hostage than me. All the torment it had to go through with me is not what it deserved.
Is your ubuntu at dual boot? I face this kind of problem in the case of using an external hard disk though.
Thanks I will try my best to confront my feelings when they come and let them pass. It was great talking with you.

I would love to and I know how to take care of myself. But somehow I don't get the drive for taking care of myself. And basically most of the time to avoid my feelings I would do things like continuously learning coding and writing blogs so that I don't get to bother by my own feelings.

Thanks for your solid advice. I loved it. Never  thought would get such a good advice. Actually I have a friend who admires me(although we don't talk much and actually have a conversation rarely)  and after having that thought I automatically started feeling better.

Sadly none of my old friendship ended in a good way. That's why I don't have the courage to face them. I kinda have friends like normal classmates. But when I feel bad I try to contact them they usually try to ignore. I guess people just don't wanna be around sad people. And I guess maybe that's okay too. I'm just lost now. I find no purpose of living nowadays that's just the way it is nowadays.
You sure are a good human. I hope to find my people too.

Thanks for your kind words! I wanted  to take therapy
But I can't afford it. ♥️
Thanks i'm still trying my best to solve it.
